user_story: As a guest, I want to create a booking with my name, room type, and dates so that I can reserve a room.

positive.title: Successfully create a booking with valid details
steps: Fill in the guest name with a valid name
Select a room type from the options available
Select valid start and end dates for the booking
positive.expected_result: The booking is created successfully and a confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Fail to create a booking with missing guest name
steps: Leave the guest name field empty
Select a room type from the options available
Select valid start and end dates for the booking
negative.expected_result: An error message stating 'Guest name is required' is displayed.

edge.title: Create a booking for a single day stay
steps: Fill in the guest name with a valid name
Select a room type from the options available
Select the same start and end date for the booking
edge.expected_result: The booking is created successfully, allowing a single day reservation, and a confirmation message is displayed.
